comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Sells life science lab instruments, storage systems, consumables and genomic services to biopharma and research labs, overlapping Thermo's lab and service offerings.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Makes food, supplement and animal ingredients plus sterilization gases; it does not sell scientific instruments or lab reagents to life science labs.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Sells research reagents, antibodies, PCR instruments and clinical diagnostic kits to labs, hospitals and pharma, closely matching Thermo's core lines.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Makes research reagents, antibodies, instruments and diagnostic tests for labs and biopharma, closely matching Thermo's life science tools and diagnostics.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Distributes industrial MRO supplies and test equipment to manufacturers and contractors, a different industrial distribution business.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Core business is government biodefense vaccines and antidotes; its contract manufacturing is secondary to Thermo's broad lab tools and diagnostics.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Makes quality control instruments, indicators and sample preparation equipment sold to labs and pharma manufacturers, overlapping Thermo's lab instruments.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Makes medical, dental and infection prevention products plus health IT and coding services for providers, not life science tools.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Its core is radiation-based contract sterilization of medical devices and radiation sources, not lab instruments or reagents for life science labs.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Core business is hospital sterilizers, surgical tables and infection prevention consumables sold to hospitals and dental practices.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Distributes and calibrates industrial test and measurement instruments for manufacturers, a different industrial service business.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Core is industrial coding and marking printers plus water quality instruments for utilities and manufacturers, not life science tools.
